name: Sound Mirror
text: You twist not just the visual, but the auditory as well, allowing you to pass without a sound and create minor noises as distractions—perfect for misdirection and infiltration. You can cast Silence on yourself as a 2nd-rank innate occult spell and Ventriloquism as a 1st-rank innate occult spell, each once per day. You also can cast Figment as an innate occult cantrip. You become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics, and your key spellcasting attribute for alter ego archetype spells is Charisma.
